$comment: Maps /workflow pipeline moments to Atoll board columns (statuses) per project. blitz moves the card automatically at each boundary via automation/atoll-move.mjs. Statuses below are the REAL keys on each board (verified). Edit the mapping to taste; if you want exact diagram columns (e.g. a dedicated 'remediation' or 'human_testing' column) I can create them with `atoll board-column create` on approval.

phases.ready: Claimed and planned — queued to build (READY TO BUILD).
phases.testing: Automated testing + QA evidence running (PRODUCTION/QA TESTING).
phases.human_gate: Waiting for human approval — preview verification or collie-review permission. In loop mode the card parks here and the loop continues; reply 'approve <ID>' to resume.
